# Docs commands

<!-- Generated by tools/agent-tool-docs.mjs from the Command type. Do not edit by hand. -->

The `apply_commands` tool takes a list of these, each a single-key object, applied in order. 10 commands.

## `updateTextStyle`

Run-level style; only keys listed in fields take effect, and null clears the property

| field                  | type                                                         | required | description                                                                                        |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `target`               | `object`                                                     | yes      |                                                                                                    |
| `target.nodeType`      | `'docHeading' \| 'docParagraph' \| 'docListItem' \| 'image'` |          | 'image' matches protected image blocks (docProtected + blockType image)                            |
| `target.headingLevel`  | `number`                                                     |          | Restrict heading level (only with nodeType: 'docHeading')                                          |
| `target.containsText`  | `string`                                                     |          | The block's plain text contains this substring (case-sensitive unless matchCase: false)            |
| `target.matchCase`     | `boolean`                                                    |          |                                                                                                    |
| `target.blockIndexes`  | `number[]`                                                   |          | By block index (the index output by buildDocumentContext, 0-based, current PM doc top-level order) |
| `target.scope`         | `'selection' \| 'document'`                                  |          | 'selection' = only blocks covered by the current selection; default = whole document               |
| `style`                | `object`                                                     | yes      |                                                                                                    |
| `style.color`          | `string \| null`                                             |          |                                                                                                    |
| `style.highlight`      | `string \| null`                                             |          |                                                                                                    |
| `style.sizeHalfPoints` | `number \| null`                                             |          |                                                                                                    |
| `style.font`           | `string \| null`                                             |          |                                                                                                    |
| `style.bold`           | `boolean`                                                    |          |                                                                                                    |
| `style.italic`         | `boolean`                                                    |          |                                                                                                    |
| `style.underline`      | `boolean`                                                    |          |                                                                                                    |
| `style.strike`         | `boolean`                                                    |          |                                                                                                    |
| `style.baselineOffset` | `'SUPERSCRIPT' \| 'SUBSCRIPT' \| 'NONE' \| null`             |          | Super/subscript (enum values aligned with Google TextStyle.baselineOffset)                         |
| `style.link`           | `{ url: string } \| null`                                    |          | Hyperlink (aligned with Google TextStyle.link); null removes the link                              |
| `fields`               | `Array<keyof UpdateTextStyle['style']>`                      | yes      |                                                                                                    |

## `setHeadingLevel`

Paragraph promote/demote; level 0 = demote to body paragraph, 1-6 = the corresponding heading level

| field                 | type                                                         | required | description                                                                                        |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `target`              | `object`                                                     | yes      |                                                                                                    |
| `target.nodeType`     | `'docHeading' \| 'docParagraph' \| 'docListItem' \| 'image'` |          | 'image' matches protected image blocks (docProtected + blockType image)                            |
| `target.headingLevel` | `number`                                                     |          | Restrict heading level (only with nodeType: 'docHeading')                                          |
| `target.containsText` | `string`                                                     |          | The block's plain text contains this substring (case-sensitive unless matchCase: false)            |
| `target.matchCase`    | `boolean`                                                    |          |                                                                                                    |
| `target.blockIndexes` | `number[]`                                                   |          | By block index (the index output by buildDocumentContext, 0-based, current PM doc top-level order) |
| `target.scope`        | `'selection' \| 'document'`                                  |          | 'selection' = only blocks covered by the current selection; default = whole document               |
| `level`               | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6`                            | yes      |                                                                                                    |

## `moveBlocks`

Move the blocks in blockIndexes (relative order kept) after afterBlockIndex; -1 = document start

| field             | type       | required | description |
| ----------------- | ---------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `blockIndexes`    | `number[]` | yes      |             |
| `afterBlockIndex` | `number`   | yes      |             |

## `createParagraphBullets`

Paragraphs to list (name and semantics aligned with Google's createParagraphBullets). BULLET*-prefixed presets = unordered, NUMBERED* = ordered; heading blocks aren't converted (counted in matched but unchanged).

| field                 | type                                                         | required | description                                                                                        |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `target.containsText` | `string`                                                     |          | The block's plain text contains this substring (case-sensitive unless matchCase: false)            |
| `target.matchCase`    | `boolean`                                                    |          |                                                                                                    |
| `target.blockIndexes` | `number[]`                                                   |          | By block index (the index output by buildDocumentContext, 0-based, current PM doc top-level order) |
| `target.scope`        | `'selection' \| 'document'`                                  |          | 'selection' = only blocks covered by the current selection; default = whole document               |
| `bulletPreset`        | `string`                                                     |          |                                                                                                    |

## `insertToc`

Insert a TOC field after the given block (a real TOC field; Word recomputes page numbers on open). Entries come from the current document's heading blocks; the command fails when there are no headings.

| field             | type     | required | description                                        |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `afterBlockIndex` | `number` | yes      | Insert after this block index; -1 = document start |
